headline: Nigerian Equities Lose N718.95 Billion as All-Share Index Drops 1,107 Points
summary: The Nigerian equities market reversed recent gains on Wednesday, erasing N718.95 billion in equity market value. The All-Share Index fell by 1,107 points during the session.
why: The Nigerian Exchange is one of West Africa's primary capital markets, reflecting investor sentiment toward corporate earnings and macro liquidity.
why_moved: Widespread profit taking across major listed equities caused a sharp decline in market valuation and index points.
